    • getReferenceTypes

      public Map<Integer, IValueType<?>> getReferenceTypes()
      Specified by:
      getReferenceTypes in interface IExpressionVariableFacade
      Returns:
      The output types of the referenced variables, by variable id, as far as they were known when this card was written. This is only used when editing the card, evaluation always uses the actual variables.

    • getText

      @Nullable public String getText()
      Specified by:
      getText in interface IExpressionVariableFacade
      Returns:
      The text the expression was typed as, or null if it was not typed or is printed. This is only used when editing the card, and only while the text still reads as the expression.
